Theory preflight now lets the independent reviewer either resolve a prior finding after a source change or retract it when current source anchors show it is out of scope, contradicted, or downstream-only. This removes an immutable false-positive path without automatic runtime semantics, but the new state is not yet live-validated. Persistent genuine findings must still block; do not add theorem-family rules, another reviewer, repair agent, or routing agent.
